name: e2
description: E2 integration cost: for all 30 algorithms and every operation, (1) an E2 block with three interleaved arms: reuse (the long-lived library object, as E1), reinit (a fresh library object per call: create, operate, destroy) and prod (QChain's production function, hex in and hex out; copied verbatim for the post-quantum algorithms, the same pattern on OpenSSL for the classical ones); and (2) an E2c block with the components prod adds, each on its own and batched where shorter than 100x the timer resolution: hex decoding of inputs, object creation (init), object destruction (clean), hex encoding of outputs. One fresh process per block, 5 repetitions, approved budgets (E2c blocks are always fast).
